## Outcome

Describe the problem and the observable result of this change.

## Related issue

Link the issue or explain why a separate issue was unnecessary.

## Validation

List automated checks and manual verification performed.

## Compatibility and limitations

Describe GeoNode compatibility, migration needs, public contract changes, and known limitations.

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request has one focused outcome.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior and all relevant checks pass.
- [ ] User-visible strings use internationalization and base locale keys stay synchronized.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` reflect user-visible or public contract changes.
- [ ] GeoNode contracts come from the supported vanilla version and payloads are validated.
- [ ] Extensions import only public SDK entry points.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private data, generated build output, or unrelated changes are included.
- [ ] Third-party material retains its license and attribution.
- [ ] Visual changes include screenshots or an explanation of why they are unnecessary.
